text:
- **Go-only pm:** The Python pm is deleted from both repos, and both clones run the Go pm. The pm-harness project now lives in Yeeef/pm.
- **pm release and notes:** A new pm release is published as a minor version, because main has a breaking change. CI now refuses any release without a structured release note.
- **Site and records fixes:** The site no longer shows missing-file errors while git rewrites the records. Main no longer keeps its own copy of the records; each worktree links to them.
- **Agent request rules:** Agents now do a step themselves before they ask the owner. Questions use the structured question tool, not plain text.
